Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the temporary local suspension of certain motorcycle provisions for the operation of motorcycles in parades or public demonstrations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the operation of motorcycles in connection witha parade or public demonstration; and amending RCW 46.61.613.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.61.613 and 2010 c 8 s 9073 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of RCW 46.37.530 and 46.61.610 through 46.61.612 maybe temporarily suspended by ((the)) a local police chief ((of theWashington state patrol)), or his or her designee, with respect to theoperation of motorcycles within ((their)) his or her respectivejurisdiction((s)) in connection with a parade or public demonstration.
